name: Name
name_erklaerung: Your user name, as created by the admin.
angemeldet_bleiben_erklaerung: Stay signed in on this device for 30 days instead of 12 hours. Only turn this on for your own devices.
fehler_leer: Please enter your name and password.
fehler_gesperrt: This account is locked. Please contact the admin.
bremse: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {sekunden} more seconds.
totp_erklaerung: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp_fehler: The code is incorrect or has expired. Please try again.
totp_fehler_format: The code consists of exactly 6 digits.
wiederherstellung_umschalten: I can't access the app – use a recovery code
wiederherstellung_zurueck: Enter the code from the app instead
wiederherstellung_erklaerung: Enter one of the codes you saved when setting up 2FA. Each code works only once.
agent_weg: The control service is currently unreachable. Please try again in a minute.
ersteinrichtung_untertitel: Your FAH-NAS has just been installed. Create the first admin account now.
ersteinrichtung_erklaerung: To keep strangers out, you need the setup code. It is shown on the NAS console (screen or SSH: file /etc/fahnas/startcode). The code becomes invalid once the first admin has been created.
startcode_erklaerung: 8 characters, as shown on the console. Not case-sensitive.
startcode_fehler: The setup code has 8 characters (letters and digits).
admin_name_erklaerung: Lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9, -, _ and dot (e.g. m.mustermann). You sign in with it – on the shares too.
admin_name_fehler: User name: lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a-z, 0-9, -, _ and dot (not at the end, not doubled)
anzeigename_erklaerung: How the interface addresses you, for example “Fabian”.
passwort_erklaerung: At least 8 characters. Longer is better – a sentence with numbers and symbols is easy to remember and hard to guess.
passwort_wiederholung_fehler: The two passwords do not match.
passwort_kurz: The password needs at least 8 characters.
einrichten_erfolg: The admin account has been created. Signing you in …
einrichten_dann_anmelden: The admin account has been created. Please sign in now.
startcode_falsch: The setup code is incorrect. Check the NAS console again.
startcode_verbleibend: {anzahl} attempts left before the lockout kicks in.
schon_eingerichtet: Initial setup has already been completed. Please sign in.
einrichten_uebernommen: The existing Linux account “{name}” from the installation has been adopted. Console, SSH and sudo now use this NAS password.
bremse_lang: Too many failed attempts – signing in is blocked for another {dauer} (h:mm:ss).
